EN: Oh, what's this? GOLDAS's main server.
ZH: 哦，这是什么？GOLDAS的主服务器。

EN: Yeah, best to play it safe. Goodbye, GOLDAS.
ZH: 嗯，稳妥起见最好还是关了。再见，GOLDAS。

EN: No way this can go wrong, right?
ZH: 这怎么可能出错，对吧？

EN: It's worth a shot, right?
ZH: 值得一试，对吧？

EN: <Erase all data and shut it down>
ZH: <擦除所有数据并关闭它>

EN: <Reprogram it to obsess over ordinary rocks>
ZH: <重新编程，让它痴迷普通石头>

EN: <Reprogram it to make the Enclave peaceful>
ZH: <重新编程，让英克雷变得和平>

EN: Time to get rid of this threat once and for all.
ZH: 是时候一劳永逸地清除这个威胁了。

EN: What should we do with it?
ZH: 我们该怎么处理它？

EN: Heart of GOLDAS
ZH: GOLDAS之心

EN: I'm pretty sure I'm not supposed to know what you're talking about.
ZH: 我很确定我不应该知道你在说什么。

EN: I get it. I mean... I *don't* get it. Yeah, that last one.
ZH: 我明白了。我的意思是……我不明白。是的，最后一个。

EN: Twenty, to be precise. Er, I mean... Enjoy!
ZH: 准确来说，二十。呃，我是说……享受！

EN: Welcome to our first annual E-Ster Egg Hunt!
ZH: 欢迎来到我们一年一度复活节彩蛋寻宝！

EN: Eggs are a wonderful representation of Atom, full of potential!
ZH: 鸡蛋是原子的奇妙表现，充满潜力！

EN: Deathclaw eggs most of all, because of all the power they hold in their small shells.
ZH: 死爪蛋最重要，因为那些小壳里所包含的巨大力量。

EN: May Atom smile on your fortunes!
ZH: 愿原子对你的命运微笑！

EN: Anything else we should look out for? Large, emits radiation...?
ZH: 还有什么值得我们注意的吗？大的，能发出辐射的……？

EN: This Egg Hunt is *the bomb*! Get it? The Bomb?
ZH: 这次寻蛋活动可太“炸”了！懂吗？是真·炸弹？

EN: We'll have megatons of fun!
ZH: 我们将有百万吨的乐趣！

EN: Oh yeah, that... Never mind that. Just find some eggs.
ZH: 哦，是的，那个……请别介意。只是找一些蛋。

EN: We'll find out soon after detonation... I mean, after we, uh, *atone* for our sins.
ZH: 爆炸之后我们很快就会查明……我是说，在我们呃……为罪孽“赎罪”之后。

EN: Why are you being so dramatic? Think of it more like “birthing a new sun.”
ZH: 你为什么这么大反应？把它想象成“诞生一个新的太阳。”

EN: Any luck finding those Deathclaw eggs?
ZH: 找到那些死爪蛋吗？

EN: It's tough, these critters are quite protective.
ZH: 这是很难的，这些生物们都很会保护自己。

EN: I thought I did, but it turned out to be some kind of big bomb?
ZH: 我想我找到了，但其实他们是某种大炸弹？

EN: Do you really think this will save daylight?
ZH: 你真的认为这样可以“节省天光”吗？

EN: Are you guys planning on detonating a nuclear bomb?
ZH: 你们这些家伙打算引爆核弹吗？

EN: Look there, behind that pile of Deathclaw dung!
ZH: 看，在一大堆死爪粪后面！

EN: Right there, in the hidden section that can only been seen from this angle!
ZH: 就在那里，从这个角度才能看到隐藏的部分！

EN: It's the nuclear bomb! We've found it!
ZH: 是核弹！我们找到了它！

EN: Wow, it's really big and impressive, too...
ZH: 哇，真是又大又气派……

EN: We've been invited to the Children of Atom's annual Deathclaw Egg Hunt! This is a good opportunity to validate Brother Will's claims that the Church plans to detonate a large nuclear bomb on E-Ster Sunday...
ZH: 我们被邀请参加原子之子一年一度的死爪蛋寻宝活动！这是验证威尔修士说法的好机会——教会打算在复活节当天引爆一枚大型核弹……

EN: E-Ster Egg Hunt
ZH: 复活节彩蛋寻宝

EN: Learn more about the alleged nuclear bomb.
ZH: 了解更多有关所谓的核弹。

EN: Harvest some Deathclaw Eggs.
ZH: 收获一些死爪蛋。

EN: Find out more about the alleged nuclear bomb.
ZH: 了解更多有关所谓的核弹。

EN: I wonder if Deathclaw eggs are any good to eat...
ZH: 不知道死爪蛋好不好吃……

EN: Do you think there really is a nuclear bomb here?
ZH: 你认为这里真的有核弹吗？

EN: It teaches us about E-Ster, and the coming of the Sixth Sun.
ZH: 它告诉我们复活节，以及即将到来的第六个太阳。

EN: Er...no one important. Forget I even mentioned him.
ZH: 呃……不是什么重要人物。当我没提过。

EN: We're humble servants of Atom, not adventurers...
ZH: 我们是原子的卑微仆人，不是冒险家……

EN: Ah, you must be the Vault Dwellers sent to help us out! Atom be praised!
ZH: 啊，你一定是派来帮助我们的避难所的居民！赞美原子！

EN: I'm Brother Thaddeus, and this is Sister Olivia.
ZH: 我是萨德思兄弟（修士），这是奥利维亚修女。

EN: The sacred circuit board must be somewhere around here.
ZH: 神圣的电路板一定在这附近。

EN: This is where Brother Will was last seen.
ZH: 这就是威尔修士最后一次被见到的地方。

EN: Why is the circuit board so precious?
ZH: 为什么电路板如此珍贵？

EN: Who's Brother Will?
ZH: 谁是威尔修士？

EN: Aren't you going to help us find it?
ZH: 你们不打算帮我们找到它吗？

EN: I'm really not supposed to talk about this... About three days.
ZH: 我真的不该谈论这个……大约三天。

EN: I'm pretty sure I can't talk about it but... I fear he's lost his mind.
ZH: 我敢肯定我不能谈论它，但……我担心他失去了理智。

EN: That it's coming? Also, it's the time when the Daylight is saved, praise Atom!
ZH: 它来了？同时，也是“节省天光”的时候，赞美原子！

EN: Please, don't shoot!
ZH: 请不要开枪！

EN: I think I got separated from the group.
ZH: 我想我和队伍走散了。

EN: I thought I'd seen our missing Brother Will and tried to follow him.
ZH: 我想我看到了我们失踪的威尔修士并试图跟随他。

EN: In the end it was just a huge Mole rat standing on its hind legs.
ZH: 最后，它只是一只巨大的鼹鼠，站在它的后腿上。

EN: How long has Brother Will been missing?
ZH: 威尔修士失踪多久了？

EN: What's wrong with Brother Will?
ZH: 威尔修士怎么了？

EN: What can you tell us about E-Ster?
ZH: 关于复活节你们知道些什么？

EN: Confessor Alvarado has agreed to put a stop to radioactive spraying, and as a sign of goodwill we've agreed to help the Church recover a sacred circuit board rumored to contain data about the ancient rite of E-Ster.
ZH: 忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多已同意停止喷洒辐射物质，作为善意的表示，我们已经同意帮助教会找回一块传说存有古老复活节仪式数据的圣电路板。

EN: E-Ster is Coming
ZH: 复活节来临

EN: Recover the Sacred Circuit Board.
ZH: 找回神圣电路板。

EN: Help the Children of Atom recover an ancient artifact.
ZH: 帮助原子之子找回一个古老的神器。

EN: All this for some old legend...
ZH: 这一切都是为了一些古老的传说……

EN: Is it me, or did talking about their missing Brother make them uneasy?
ZH: 是我的问题，还是说谈论他们失踪的兄弟让他们不安？

EN: Brother Will, is that you?
ZH: 威尔修士，是你吗？

EN: Echoes of Steel
ZH: 钢铁的回声

EN: Hey! We were napping!
ZH: 嘿！我们正在打盹呢！

EN: The Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac was once a bustling hub, now overrun with raiders who call themselves Khans. We're going to turn it back into a motel.
ZH: 诺瓦克的恐龙迪莱特汽车旅馆曾经是一处繁华的据点，如今却被一群自称大汗帮的掠夺者所占据。我们要把它还原成一家旅馆。

EN: Eviction Notice
ZH: 驱逐令

EN: Ask the Khans to leave
ZH: 要求大汗帮离开

EN: Get the Khans out of the Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac.
ZH: 把大汗帮赶出诺瓦克的恐龙迪莱特旅馆。

EN: This is Khan territory! What do you want?
ZH: 这是大汗帮领地！你想干什么？

EN: That sounds like a challenge! Let's fight!
ZH: 这听起来像是挑衅！打吧！

EN: No, it's not. It's Khan territory. We stole it! If you want it back, fight us for it!
ZH: 不，不是。这是大汗帮领地，我们抢来的！你要想夺回去，就跟我们打！

EN: Very well, you may pass. Sorry if you get attacked on the way.
ZH: 好吧，你可以过去。如果路上挨打了，别怪我们。

EN: Could it maybe not be Khan territory?
ZH: 也许可以不是大汗帮领地吗？

EN: Actually, this is a motel.
ZH: 其实，这是一家旅馆。

EN: Let me talk to your boss, please!
ZH: 请让我和你们的老大说话！

EN: You now face the Crazy Khans! If they like you, they won't kill you. Do the Crazy Khans like you?
ZH: 你现在面对的是疯狂大汗帮！如果他们喜欢你，就不会杀你。疯狂大汗帮喜欢你吗？

EN: Hahahaha! Sure we can. But we won't, because you're so nice.
ZH: 哈哈哈！当然我们可以。但我们不会，因为你们太好了。

EN: How about this for welcoming?
ZH: 来，感受一下什么叫热情款待？

EN: Don't make the Crazy Khans think! Philosophy is for the boss only!
ZH: 别让疯狂大汗帮动脑子！哲学是老大的专属！

EN: We're really nice! Also you can't kill us.
ZH: 我们超级好的！再说你们也杀不了我们。

EN: That's not a very welcoming attitude.
ZH: 这态度也太不友善了吧。

EN: I wonder if the Crazy Khans like the Crazy Khans.
ZH: 我想知道疯狂大汗帮喜不喜欢疯狂大汗帮自己。

EN: Word of your coming reached me before you even stepped foot in my halls. What do you wish?
ZH: 你来此之前，我已经知道你的消息了。你有何所求？

EN: Hmph. No, I am not in. If you want to take the territory, then take it by force as we did!
ZH: 哼，不，我不愿意。如果你想夺走这片领地，就像我们一样，用武力来取！

EN: Novac has never been so strong and free. Here, I'll show you just how free you can be!
ZH: 诺瓦克从来没有这么强大自由过。来，我让你亲身体验一下何谓自由！

EN: Give it a few days, and you will smell much worse than we do!
ZH: 等几天，你会比我们更臭的！

EN: We want this to be a motel again. You in?
ZH: 我们想把这里变回旅馆，你愿意吗？

EN: You're killing the vibe in Novac.
ZH: 你们毁了诺瓦克的氛围。

EN: I hate to say this, but… you're all too smelly.
ZH: 不得不说……你们身上有点味儿。

EN: Hey look, this place is full of cool stuff. Check it out! A real swim suit!
ZH: 嘿，这地方有不少好东西。看看！一件真正的泳衣！

EN: Never know when you might find a swimming pool in the wasteland…
ZH: 在废土上说不定哪天就能找到游泳池……

EN: These Khans are so careless. Leaving all this nice stuff lying around!
ZH: 这些大汗帮真粗心，把这么多好东西随便乱放！

EN: Found this in the rubble. You want it, it's yours.
ZH: 在碎石堆里找到了这个。你要的话就给你。

EN: Look, I'm sorry. A Ghoul's gotta eat. You want this instead?
ZH: 听着，我很抱歉。尸鬼也得吃东西。要不你拿这个？

EN: Nah, I just bumped into them. Say, you want this?
ZH: 不用了，我只是恰好碰上了。你是说你想要这个？

EN: Doesn't everybody?! There may not be any left, but I did find this...
ZH: 难道有人不想吗？！说不定再也没有了，不过我确实发现了这个……

EN: Well, this is awkward. If you were looking for any Dandy Boy Apples, I uhh... I ate 'em all.
ZH: 呃，这可有点尴尬。如果你是在找“花花公子苹果”的话……我……全吃了。

EN: Anything else left around here?
ZH: 这里还有剩下的吗？

EN: But I had a craving!
ZH: 但我真的很想吃！

EN: Were those Ferals friends of yours?
ZH: 那些尸鬼是你的朋友吗？

EN: Ghouls like Dandy Boy Apples?
ZH: 尸鬼喜欢“花花公子苹果”吗？

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers stumbled upon a Super-Duper Mart. Surely there's something useful inside.
ZH: 一位探索废土的居民途经了一个大无敌超市。里面应该会有些有用的东西。

EN: Express Checkout
ZH: 快捷收银台

EN: Search the Super-Duper Mart.
ZH: 搜索大无敌超市。

EN: Clear out the Super-Duper Mart.
ZH: 清空大无敌超市。

EN: What?
ZH: 什么？

EN: Some strange signals are interfering with our radio transmissions out in the waste. Take a squad with you and triangulate the interference. Once you know where it's coming from, investigate the site and disable whatever is blocking our Radio.
ZH: 废土中有一些奇怪的信号干扰了我们的无线电传输。带上一队人马，定位干扰源。一旦知道干扰信号的来源，就去调查那个地方，处理掉干扰我们无线电的东西。

EN: Extreme Outerference
ZH: 极端干扰

EN: Investigate the strange signals
ZH: 调查奇怪的信号

EN: Investigate the strange signals
ZH: 调查奇怪的信号

EN: Makes sense.
ZH: 有道理。

EN: I saw that! It's an honor to meet you. And kill you.
ZH: 我看到了！很荣幸认识你。然后杀了你。

EN: Ha! I bet you would, too!
ZH: 哈！我打赌你也会！

EN: Hey. You.
ZH: 嘿，你。

EN: I haven't seen you before, yet you look vaguely familiar.
ZH: 我以前没见过你，但你看起来有点眼熟。

EN: Are you some kind of spy?
ZH: 你是间谍吗？

EN: I have a very common face, it helps to infiltrate the enemy.
ZH: 我有一张大众脸，它有助于渗透敌人。

EN: Well, I did make the cover of Spy Quarterly.
ZH: 嗯，我确实上过间谍季刊的封面。

EN: I *wish* I was a spy, so I could just kill you all.
ZH: 我真希望我是间谍，所以我可以杀了你们所有人。

EN: Mike?
ZH: 迈克？

EN: Oh, right, he is. Heh. Good ol' Mike.
ZH: 哦，对了，他是。嘿嘿。好人迈克。

EN: Te voy a matar, cabron!
ZH: 我会杀了你的！

EN: Have you seen Mike around, by any chance?
ZH: 你们见到迈克了吗？

EN: You know who I'm talking about, right?
ZH: 你知道我在说谁吧？

EN: Of course I do! He's...uh...he's right over there, look!
ZH: 我当然会！他……呃……他就在那边，看！

EN: Don't kid... Mike's been dead for weeks.
ZH: 别开玩笑了……迈克已经死了好几个星期了。

EN: Lo siento, no hablo inglés.
ZH: 不好意思，我听不懂。

EN: “All Dwellers must carry ID at all times.” We have to shoot you now.
ZH: “所有的居民都必须随身携带身份证。”我们必须得开枪了。

EN: You know, I'm not sure... Let me get back to you on that.
ZH: 你知道，我不太确定……回头再答复你。

EN: Never heard of fist prints before, but I supp- Ooh, I get it.
ZH: 以前从没听说过拳印，但我想——哦，我懂了。

EN: I'm sorry, but we need to check your ID.
ZH: 对不起，我们需要检查您的身份证。

EN: Apparently someone has been trying to infiltrate this Vault.
ZH: 显然有人一直试图渗透进这个避难所。

EN: Infiltrate...with extreme prejudice.
ZH: 用极端偏见……来渗透。

EN: I left it in my other Vault Suit.
ZH: 我把它留在我的另一个避难所套装里了。

EN: What does that mean anyway, “extreme prejudice”?
ZH: “极端偏见”到底什么意思？

EN: Does my fist count as ID?
ZH: 我的拳头算身份证吗？

EN: Pffft. Good luck!
ZH: 切。祝你好运！

EN: Is that some kind of threat?
ZH: 这是一种威胁吗？

EN: Steve, all-knowing? You're clearly *not* from here...
ZH: 史蒂夫，无所不知？你显然不是来自于这里……

EN: Hey, could you help settle an argument we're having?
ZH: 嘿，你能帮我们解决争吵吗？

EN: They say the Overseer will find a new Vault for us any moment now.
ZH: 他们说，监督者会随时找到一个新的避难所给我们。

EN: I think we'll be stuck in this crappy second-rate Vault forever.
ZH: 我想我们会永远困在这蹩脚的二流避难所里。

EN: What do you think, fellow Dweller that I can't quite place?
ZH: 这位我一时认不出是谁的同胞，你怎么看？

EN: I'm on my way to see the Overseer. I can ask him if you want.
ZH: 我正要去见监督者。如果你愿意，我可以问问他。

EN: You'll live out the rest of your days here, i.e. a couple of minutes.
ZH: 你会在这里度过剩下的日子，也就是几分钟。

EN: Your... I mean, *our* Overseer is all-knowing. Surely he's telling the truth.
ZH: 你的……我的意思是，我们的监督者什么都知道。他肯定说的是实话。

EN: This dump? Have you actually looked at it? It stinks!
ZH: 这堆垃圾？你们真的仔细看过吗？太臭了！

EN: It's awesome! Your Overseer is  the best! A true genius, and immune to flattery, too.
ZH: 棒极了。你的监督者是最好的！一个真正的天才，也不吃拍马屁那套。

EN: ...says the hired assassin.
ZH: 雇佣刺客说……

EN: No, Secret Agent Person, I expect you to die.
ZH: 不，特工人员，我希望你死。

EN: Well, well, well...
ZH: 这个嘛这个嘛……

EN: I guess it was just a matter of time before you showed up.
ZH: 我看你出现在这儿，不过是早晚的事。

EN: Too bad you will fail, and your Vault will be ours!
ZH: 可惜你会失败，你的避难所将是我们的！

EN: You already have a Vault.
ZH: 你已经有一个避难所了。

EN: Why *our* Vault, out of all of them?
ZH: 为什么所有的这些避难所，你们选择了我们的？

EN: Can't we just all get along?
ZH: 我们就不能和睦相处吗？

EN: Well you got me. Do you expect me to talk?
ZH: 你难倒我了。你指望我会招供吗？

EN: The information we got from Harkness is troubling: it reveals a rival Vault Overseer is behind all of the recent attacks against us. We need to send a single assassin to infiltrate the Vault and take out its leader... with extreme prejudice.
ZH: 我们从哈克尼斯那里收到的信息令人担忧：一位同我们竞争的避难所监督者是最近所有攻击的幕后黑手。我们需要派一名刺客潜入他们的避难所，毫不留情地干掉他们的首领。

EN: Extreme Prejudice
ZH: 极端偏见

EN: Eliminate the evil Overseer.
ZH: 消灭邪恶的监督者。

EN: Take out a hostile Vault Overseer.
ZH: 拿下一个敌对避难所的首领。

EN: Don't worry, this won't take long.
ZH: 别担心，这不会花很长时间。

EN: *sigh* You had to pick the hard way...Extreme Prejudice!
ZH: *叹息*你偏要选择艰难的方式……极端偏见！

EN: Looks like we're both a little hard of hearing. But you've got bigger problems!
ZH: 看来咱俩听力都不太好。不过你的麻烦可大得多！

EN: Funny, I was just about to say the same thing to you!
ZH: 呵呵，我正想和你讲同样的话！

EN: Nope, but I'll go find out as soon as I'm finished with you!
ZH: 没，但我要和你了结之后再说！

EN: Doesn't matter to you - you'll be dead in a minute!
ZH: 对你来说无所谓——反正你马上就要死了！

EN: I heard scratching sounds, but thought it was just animals.
ZH: 我听到了抓挠的声音，但我以为只是动物发出的。

EN: Turns out it's just some dumb Vault Dwellers instead!
ZH: 结果发现只是某些愚蠢的避难所居民！

EN: You ain't getting whatever's in this place! I got here first!
ZH: 你们在这里什么都得不到！我先到的！

EN: I don't care what's in my way, whether it's bugs or chumps like you!
ZH: 我根本不在乎谁挡我的路，不论是虫子还是你们这种傻瓜！

EN: Didn't you hear? Everyone is supposed to stay away from this place.
ZH: 你们没听说吗？每个人都应该远离这个地方。

EN: You're gonna get yourself killed in here.
ZH: 你会死在这里的。

EN: Any idea why this place is off limits?
ZH: 你们知道为什么这里是禁区吗？

EN: You heard scratching sounds? Coming from where?
ZH: 你听到了抓挠的声音？从哪里传来的？
